units.source_text: 朱雀院又说：“我想等候三公主年事渐长，知识渐开，一直忍耐至今。

en.t: The Suzaku Retired Emperor said again, "I have endured until now, hoping to wait until the Third Princess grew older and her understanding opened.

units.source_text: 但长此下去，使我不能成遂出家之大愿，实甚可虑，因此极盼早日定夺。

en.t: But if things go on like this, I fear I will be unable to fulfill my great wish to take religious vows, so I very much hope the matter will be settled soon.

units.source_text: 六条院主人识见高远，老成持重，实为最可信赖之人。

en.t: The master of Rokujo-in has lofty judgment, mature steadiness, and is truly the most trustworthy person.

units.source_text: 至于姬妾众多，其实无关紧要。

en.t: As for his many ladies and consorts, that is really of no importance.

units.source_text: 因为或善或恶，皆由本人心意造成。

en.t: For whether things turn out good or bad depends entirely on the person’s own heart.

units.source_text: 六条院主人气度雍容，仪态稳重，可为世人典型。

en.t: The master of Rokujo-in has a graceful bearing and dignified manner, and may serve as a model for the world.

units.source_text: 世间没有比他更可信赖的人了。

en.t: There is no one in the world more trustworthy than he is.

units.source_text: 宜为三公主夫婿者，除却此君而外，更有何人？

en.t: Who else but this gentleman could be suitable as the Third Princess’s husband?

units.source_text: 萤兵部卿亲王人品也很端正。

en.t: Prince Hotaru, Minister of War, is also a man of very upright character.

units.source_text: 我与他同为皇子，不宜视同外人而加以贬斥。

en.t: Since he and I are both imperial princes, I should not treat him like an outsider and disparage him.

units.source_text: 然而此人过分耽好风雅，缺乏威严，不免偏于轻率，毕竟不可信赖。

en.t: Yet he is too absorbed in elegance and refinement, lacks dignity, and inevitably leans toward frivolity, so in the end he cannot be trusted.

units.source_text: 藤大纳言愿为三公主当家臣，用意备极诚恳，然而总觉不甚相称。

en.t: Fuji Dainagon wishes to serve the Third Princess as a household retainer, and his intentions are extremely sincere, but somehow he does not seem quite suitable.

units.source_text: 此种身份平凡之人，到底是不足道的。

en.t: A person of such ordinary rank is, after all, hardly worth considering.

units.source_text: 自古以来，凡公主择婿，必须其人有特殊之声望，方为合格。

en.t: Since ancient times, when a princess chooses a husband, the man must have some special renown before he can be considered qualified.

units.source_text: 若仅因其人热爱公主，即视为贤婿而选定之，则缺陷必多，遗憾无穷。

en.t: If one chooses a man as a worthy husband merely because he loves the princess deeply, there will be many flaws and endless regrets.

units.source_text: 据尚侍胧月夜说：右卫门督柏木私下恋慕三公主。

en.t: According to Oborozukiyo, the Naishi no Kami, Kashiwagi, Captain of the Right Gate Watch, secretly loves the Third Princess.

units.source_text: 可惜只是个右卫门督，倘能再晋升，有了相当的官位，倒也未始不可考虑。

en.t: Unfortunately he is only Captain of the Right Gate Watch; if he could be promoted further and gain a suitable rank, he might not be impossible to consider.

units.source_text: 不过此人年纪很轻，还只二十四岁，全无稳重之相。

en.t: But he is very young, only twenty-four, and shows no sign of steadiness at all.

units.source_text: 他选择配偶，志望甚高，因此至今还是鳏居。

en.t: He has very high ambitions in choosing a spouse, and therefore remains unmarried to this day.

units.source_text: 然而从容悠闲，孤高自赏。

en.t: Even so, he is calm and leisurely, aloof and pleased with himself.

units.source_text: 其态度拔类超群，其才学亦迥不犹人。

en.t: His bearing stands out far above others, and his talent and learning are likewise quite unlike ordinary people’s.

units.source_text: 可知将来一定飞黄腾达，前途发迹可操左券。

en.t: It is clear that he will surely rise high in the future, and his prospects for success are all but certain.

units.source_text: 然而要做三公主夫婿，毕竟还欠一筹。”

en.t: Yet to become the Third Princess’s husband, he is still, after all, one step short."

units.source_text: 他左思右想，无限烦恼。

en.t: He turned the matter over and over in his mind, troubled without end.
